description: This PHP class defines acceptance testing steps for interacting with a list view in a SuiteCRM application. It provides methods to click on record names, filter, clear filters, and wait for specific UI elements to become visible or hidden, facilitating automated UI tests.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: Acceptance test helper class for interacting with and asserting the state of list views in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: clickNameLink
methods.description: Clicks on the name link of a specific record in the list view.

methods.name: clickFilterButton
methods.description: Clicks on the filter button to open the filter modal.

methods.name: clearFilterButton
methods.description: Clears any applied filters by resetting the filter form and submitting a search.

methods.name: waitForListViewVisible
methods.description: Waits until the list view body is visible in the UI.

methods.name: waitForFilterModalVisible
methods.description: Waits until the filter modal dialog is visible.

methods.name: waitForFilterModalNotVisible
methods.description: Waits until the filter modal dialog is no longer visible.
